next.reason: 1985: 'the same presence or absence of a sign as the quotient (identifier-3)'; 2023: 'a subsidiary quotient is developed that is signed and derived from the quotient by truncation of digits'. Both define remainder as dividend minus truncated quotient times divisor, but 2023 always uses a signed subsidiary quotient. 1985 follows identifier-3's sign, so unsigned quotients differ.
